# Private AI

> A private AI operating layer for individuals and families, designed to remember from sources, coordinate across life and remain under the owner's control.

English page: https://ai.bonar1.com/
Hebrew page: https://ai.bonar1.com/he/
Builder: Etgar Bonar
Contact: ai@bonar1.com

## What exists today

- Capability: daily use through WhatsApp and Telegram, with focused agents for travel, groceries, chores, allowance and finance.
- Reliability: deterministic self-audits, canary checks, provider fallbacks, offsite backups, a recovery runbook and an incident log.
- Governance: task-scoped tools, human approval for durable memory and sensitive actions, plus recurring usage and cost reviews.
- Architecture: the operating layer and readable knowledge base run on a private home server. External AI models are interchangeable services.

## Current boundary

This is a working personal system running in one household, not an off-the-shelf product. Etgar is holding a small number of private conversations with people interested in a similar system built around their lives.
